zh.title: 文件没写坏，为什么上一次更新还是没了？
zh.summary: 两份旧会话快照先后保存，文件始终完整，却丢了一项更新；重新读取后两项都保留。我们对照 CodeFlowMu 会话元数据与 FCoP 的独立报告文件。

en.title: The file is intact. Where did the other update go?
en.summary: Two stale session snapshots were saved successfully to one intact file, but one update disappeared. Reloading before the second save retained both; independent FCoP reports behaved differently.
